svg.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Two frames become one strip of half-frame film: one canvas, one export. Proposal 2026-10-02, for review.
A · States and how you move between them
same look, or one untouched: no sheet
Swap · Layout · Gap · pick a half
Unpair: two frames again, keeping the pair’s look (shared groups already in both sidecars)
Every arrow is one undo step. Undo of “Pair” restores both
sidecars exactly as they were, including a look the sheet replaced.
B · What the two halves share (D4)
Film stock, Print stock, Film Format (forced 135 half, 24 mm), Enlarger
Grain / halation / glare strengths, Film Edge, Date Back face and size
Exposure, metering, white balance, Scene Placement, Latitude view
each shot had its own light
Crop inside the slot, straighten, flips
stored in the pair, not the frame
Order, layout, gap colour and width
C · How a pair renders: the engine is not changed
No new engine field, no API-SPEC change:
nothing that collides with the mobile
engine port. Each half is an ordinary
frame render; only the layout is new.
Later, with Film Edge on desktop:
and the two canvases abut into a strip.
Pixel size of the composed pair
• Each half is cropped to its slot: 3:4 side by side, 4:3 stacked.
• Slot height H = the smaller of the two cropped heights, so neither
half is upscaled; the larger one is downsampled to H.
• Slot width = H × 18/24. Gap = H × width_mm / 24 (1.0 mm → H/24).
• Two 4000×6000 portraits: the 3:4 crop keeps all 4000 px of width,
(44 MP). The canvas shows a downsampled preview.
• Export’s “long edge” sizes the whole pair, not each half.
the left half’s EXIF and date; both file names in the description
A picked pair counts as one item in “Export 3”. The row shows only when a pair is picked.
Batch export keeps today’s rule (select, develop, write, next): a pair develops
its two halves one after the other, composes, writes, and releases both before
the next item, so peak memory is two developed frames, the same as A/B today.
